site_name: Iona Tower, 33 Ross Way, LONDON, E14 7GG
description: Application for certificate of Lawfulness in respect of:Proposed removal of combustible timber decking, insulation, timber planters and timber enclosures around plant to 6th and 12th floor areas of Iona Tower. Replacement will be with non-combustible aluminium decking, planters and enclosures to 6th and 12th floors. Reinstalling the existing lighting systems, Where units are non functional, replacements will be like for like, IP rated and matched to the new planter colours to avoid lumens nusiance.   Replacing the insulation to the roof build-up where non-compartmented as required by the fire engineer. Terrace design will ensure: - Terrace size, footprint, height, thickness, and profile remain unchanged.Edge alignment and platform projection remain unchanged.Surface pattern and texture will be visually similar.No visible substructure changes. Material and Colour Choices:Decking: Dark brown to match existing timber.Planters, enclosures, and ramps: Whisper grey to replicate the appearance of bleached timber.Colours comply with DDA requirements, ensuring a 30-point Light Reflectance Value (LRV) difference between decking, planters, and the existing ramp to level 6.Compliance and Accessibility:Ramp access introduced to the 6th and 12th floors, replacing existing steps, to meet DDA standards.Integrated seating within aluminium planters to maintain functionality and ensure secure fixing against wind exposure.All terrace materials will be non-combustible.Visual Impact:Changes are not visible from ground level.Planning advice confirms the proposal qualifies for a lawful development certificate as the works do not alter the building's external appearance given the location and materiality.
